# 00000000001

**English.** Definition: The decimal digit sum s(p) of a prime p is the sum of its digits. Conjecture: There exist infinitely many primes p such that s(p) is a perfect square; moreover, the density of such primes equals the value predicted by the logarithm-squared heuristic. (prime digit-square density)

**中文。** 定义：素数的十进制数字和 s(p) 为各位数字之和。猜想：存在无穷多个素数 p 使 s(p) 为完全平方数；且此类素数的密度为对数平方窗内的预期值。（素数数字平方密度）
========================================
# 00000000002

**English.** Definition: A Beatty sequence is the integer sequence ⌊nα+β⌋. Conjecture: For every irrational α greater than one and every real β, the count of primes in the Beatty sequence satisfies the expected asymptotic density formula with an error term of logarithmic size. (Beatty prime asymptotics)

**中文。** 定义：Beatty 序列指 ⌊nα+β⌋ 的整数序列。猜想：对每个无理 α 大于一与实数 β，Beatty 序列中的素数计数满足渐近密度的预期公式且误差为对数窗。（Beatty 素数渐近）
========================================
# 00000000003

**English.** Conjecture: Every sufficiently large even integer N can be written as N = p + P₂, where p is a prime with p ≤ N^θ for some θ < 1/2, and P₂ denotes a product of at most two primes.

**中文。** 猜想：每个充分大的偶数 N 都可写成 N = p + P₂,其中 p 为素数且 p ≤ N^θ(某个 θ < 1/2),P₂ 表示至多两个素数之积。

# 00000000006

**English.** Conjecture: Let A ⊂ [N] be such that the average of any two of its elements of the same parity is never prime; then |A| ≤ (1/3+ε)N, and the lower bound 1/3 is asymptotically attained by the multiples of 3.

# 00000000007

Conjecture: The number of primes in A is either finite, or A asymptotically contains an infinite subsequence of a geometric-type sequence {c·bⁿ+d}; in other words, primality in a sparse automatic set can only arise along a single-exponential trajectory.

**中文。** 定义：设 A ⊂ N 为自动机可识别且 #A ∩ [1,x] ≪ log x(稀疏自动集)。猜想：A 中素数个数要么有限,要么 A 渐近包含一个几何型序列 {c·bⁿ+d} 的无穷子列;换言之,稀疏自动集中的素性只能来自单指数轨迹。

# 00000000010

**English.** Definition: The second-order structure of the prime-value count of a square-free integer polynomial f: the Bateman–Horn constant C_f and the leading deviation term. Conjecture: The count of prime values satisfies Π_f(x) = C_f·Li(x^{1/2}) + O(x^{1/4+ε}), where C_f is the product of local densities with convergence exponent the logarithm of the discriminant; the deviation exponent 1/4 is optimal — there is an explicit family of f for which the mean-square deviation is at least x^{1/2}/log²x; and C_f admits the explicit bounds 1/(2 log D_f) ≤ C_f ≤ 2 log D_f.

**中文。** 定义：无重根整系数多项式 f 的素值计数的二阶结构：Bateman–Horn 常数 C_f 与偏差主项。猜想：f 取素值的计数满足 Π_f(x) = C_f·Li(x^{1/2})+O(x^{1/4+ε})，其中 C_f 为局部密度乘积且收敛指数为判别式的对数；偏差项指数 1/4 为最优——存在显式 f 族使均方偏差不低于 x^{1/2}/log²x；C_f 的显式上下界为 1/(2 log D_f) ≤ C_f ≤ 2 log D_f。

# 00000000022

**English.** Definition: The saturation scale of Chebotarev counting: the smallest x at which the ratio of π_C(x) to its main term first enters the 1/2-neighborhood and remains there permanently. Conjecture: For zero-free extensions the saturation scale is at most exp(L^{1+o(1)}), where L is the logarithm of the discriminant; if an exceptional zero β exists, the saturation delay is at least (1−β)^{-1} and at most its square; the delay is inversely proportional to the width of the zero-free region with proportionality constant 1; and the difference between the saturation scales of a fixed conjugacy class C and of the unit class is at most a constant multiple of log L.

**中文。** 定义：Chebotarev 计数的饱和尺度：π_C(x) 与主项之比首次进入 1/2 邻域并永久停留的最小 x。猜想：零点自由扩张的饱和尺度不超过 exp(L^{1+o(1)})，L 为判别式对数；存在例外零点 β 时饱和延迟至少 (1-β)^{-1} 且不超过其平方；延迟与零点自由区域宽度成反比且比例常数为 1；固定共轭类 C 的饱和尺度与单位类的饱和尺度之差不超过 log L 的常数倍。

# 00000000025

**English.** Definition: The repulsion structure of Chebotarev zeros: the coexistence pattern of the real zeros of Artin L-functions in the interval from 1−c/log D to 1. (Deuring repulsion of Chebotarev zeros)

**中文。** 定义：Chebotarev 零点的排斥结构：Artin L 函数的实零点在从 1-c/log D 到 1 的区间内的共存模式。猜想：同一 Galois 扩张的两个非交叠不可约特征对应的 L 函数不同时拥有从 1-c/log D 到 1 区间内的零点（Deuring–Heilbronn 排斥）；排斥为对数型——次零点距主零点的距离下界为 c·log log D 除以 log D；例外零点存在当且仅当相应特征为实特征且该 Siegel 型零点在扩群内唯一。（Chebotarev 零点 Deuring 排斥）

# 00000009521

**English.** Definition: The Holevo capacity of a quantum channel phi, chi(phi) = max over ensembles {p_i, rho_i} of [S(sum p_i rho_i) - sum p_i S(rho_i)] with S the von Neumann entropy; the additivity question asks whether chi(phi tensor psi) = chi(phi) + chi(psi) holds for a given pair — Hastings proved it fails in general. Conjecture: The channels for which additivity holds against every psi form a closed cone Add; for dimensions d at least 4, Add is neither the whole space nor a low-dimensional lattice, its boundary consists of the analyticity-breaking points of chi, and the expected violation sup_psi[chi(phi tensor psi) - chi(phi) - chi(psi)] over random unitary conjugation orbits is Theta(1/d). (Holevo additivity structure domain)

**中文。** 定义：量子信道 φ 的 Holevo 容量 χ(φ)=max over 系综 {p_i,ρ_i} [S(Σp_iρ_i)−Σp_i S(ρ_i)]，S 为冯诺依曼熵；可加性问题问 χ(φ⊗ψ)=χ(φ)+χ(ψ) 是否对给定信道对成立，Hastings 已证一般不成立。猜想：使可加性对一切 ψ 成立的信道构成闭锥 Add；Add 在维数 d≥4 时既非全空间也非低维格，其边界由 χ 的解析性破裂点组成，且违反量 sup_ψ[χ(φ⊗ψ)−χ(φ)−χ(ψ)] 在随机酉共轭轨道上的期望为 Θ(1/d)。（Holevo 可加性结构域）

# 00000009522

**English.** Definition: The quantum capacity Q(phi) is the supremal rate of reliable quantum state transmission with arbitrarily many uses, given by the LSD regularization Q(phi) = lim_n (1/n) max_rho I_c(rho, phi^{tensor n}), where I_c(rho,phi) = S(phi(rho)) - S(phi^c(rho)) is the coherent information and phi^c the complementary channel; the private capacity P(phi) is regularized similarly. Conjecture: P(phi) at least Q(phi) for every channel, and both strict inequalities P > Q and Q > 0 are positive-measure events in the channel space of dimension d at least 3; the ratio P(phi)/Q(phi) has no uniform upper bound at fixed dimension, i.e. there exist channel families making the ratio arbitrarily large. (private-quantum capacity separation)

**中文。** 定义：量子容量 Q(φ) 为无穷次使用下可靠量子态传输速率的上确界，由 LSD 正则化 Q(φ)=lim_n (1/n) max_ρ I_c(ρ,φ^{⊗n}) 给出，I_c(ρ,φ)=S(φ(ρ))−S(φ^c(ρ)) 为相干信息；私人容量 P(φ) 同样正则化定义，φ^c 为互补信道。猜想：P(φ)≥Q(φ) 对一切信道成立且严格不等式 P>Q 与 Q>0 在维数 d≥3 的信道空间中均为正测度事件；比值 P(φ)/Q(φ) 在固定维数下无一致上界，即可构造信道族使该比值任意大。（私人-量子容量分离）

# 00000009524

**English.** Definition: The coherent information I_c(rho,phi) = S(phi(rho)) - S(phi^c(rho)); the quantum capacity Q(phi) is its regularization, and the single-letterization question is whether sup_rho I_c(rho,phi) already equals Q(phi). **中文。** 定义：相干信息 I_c(ρ,φ)=S(φ(ρ))−S(φ^c(ρ))；量子容量 Q(φ) 是 I_c 的正则化，单字母化问题即 sup_ρ I_c(ρ,φ) 是否已等于 Q(φ)。猜想：对 Haar 随机选取的 d 维信道，以趋于 1 的概率 sup_ρ I_c ≤ Q(φ) ≤ sup_ρ I_c + O(1/d)，即随机信道近似单字母化；且该随机类与单字母化已证的 degradable 类之交为零测集。（LSD 单字母化）

Conjecture: The finitistic dimension of a finite-dimensional algebra is controlled by twice the Loewy length; the doubling coefficient of the bound is optimal, attained by explicit subalgebras of exterior algebras, and the bound is independent of quiver size. (finitistic dimension Loewy doubling bound)

**中文。** 定义：有限维数。猜想：有限维代数的整体维数有限的模的维数上确界有限性。猜想：有限维代数的有限维数被 Loewy 长度的两倍控制；界的两倍系数为最优且由外代数的显式子代数达到，界不依赖箭图规模。（有限维数 Loewy 双倍界）
========================================
# 00000009995

**English.** Definition: Algebraic growth of torsion-free nilpotent groups: Gelfand-Kirillov dimension and growth functions. Conjecture: The growth function of the group algebra of a torsion-free nilpotent group is an exact power law: the growth rate is a power of the total rank of the group, and the secondary term of the power law is a log-periodic function; the period is an explicit function of the structure constants of the lattice. (nilpotent group growth exact power law)

**中文。** 定义：无挠幂零群的代数增长：Gelfand–Kirillov 维数与增长函数。猜想：无挠幂零群代数的增长函数为精确幂律：增长率为群的总秩的幂且幂律的次级项为对数周期函数；周期为格的构造常数的显式函数。（幂零群增长精确幂律）
========================================
# 00000009996

**English.** Definition: Prime spectra of quantum affine spaces: the spectral structure of noncommutative torus-type deformations. Conjecture: The prime spectrum of a quantum affine space is catenary if and only if the multiplicative subgroup of deformation parameters has no repeated relations; catenarity is equivalent to Zariski Noetherianity, and verifying the equivalence is a finite computation on the parameter group. (quantum space catenary equivalence)

**中文。** 定义：量子仿射空间的素谱：非交换 torus 型变形的谱结构。猜想：量子仿射空间的素谱 catenary 当且仅当变形参数的乘性子群无重复关系；catenarity与 Zariski Noether 性等价且等价性的验证为参数群的有限计算。（量子空间 catenary 等价）
========================================
# 00000009997

**English.** Definition: Noncommutative unique factorization: the noncommutative version of homogeneous prime element factorization. Conjecture: The weak Euclidean criterion of noncommutative UFDs: left coefficient division is feasible if and only if common multiples of homogeneous primes are commutativizable; the criterion is verified explicitly by the Euclidean property of the reduced norm. (noncommutative UFD weak Euclidean criterion)

**中文。** 定义：非交换唯一分解：齐次素元分解的非交换版。猜想：非交换 UFD 的弱欧几里得判据：左系数除法可行当且仅当齐次素元的公倍数为可交换化；判据由约化范的 Euclid 性显式验证。（非交换 UFD 弱欧氏判据）
========================================
# 00000009998

**English.** Definition: Central polynomials: central-valued polynomials of matrix algebras (Formanek's construction proves existence). Conjecture: The minimal degree of a central polynomial of the n by n matrix algebra is exactly n squared, and the attaining polynomial is unique up to isomorphism and transpose; uniqueness exceptions appear from n = 4, forming finite-parameter families. (central polynomial minimal degree)

**中文。** 定义：中心多项式：矩阵代数的中心值多项式（Formanek 构造存在性已知）。猜想：n 阶矩阵代数的中心多项式的最小次数恰为 n 的平方且达到的多项式在同构与转置下唯一；唯一性的例外从 n=4 起出现且例外为有限参数族。（中心多项式最小次数）
========================================
# 00000009999

**English.** Definition: Commutator structure of Weyl algebras: generating pairs of rings of differential operators. Conjecture: Solution pairs of the commutator equation AB minus BA equals the identity in the Weyl algebra form a finite-parameter family; the parameters are trace corrections of the first two algebraically independent elements, and the parameter space is a two-dimensional algebraic variety. (Weyl commutator finite parametrization)

**中文。** 定义：Weyl 代数的交换子结构：微分算子环的生成对。猜想：Weyl 代数中交换子方程 AB 减 BA 为单位元的解对为有限参数族；族的参数为前两代数独立元素的迹修正且参数空间为二维代数簇。（Weyl 交换子有限参数化）
========================================
# 00000010000

**English.** Definition: Entropy of algebraic automorphisms: algebraic entropy growth of ring automorphisms. Conjecture: The dichotomy — zero or infinite algebraic entropy of automorphisms of finitely generated algebras — holds within the PI class; the minimal algebra with intermediate entropy outside the PI class is of Veronese type, with entropy a logarithmic algebraic number. (algebraic entropy dichotomy threshold)

**中文。** 定义：代数自同构的熵：环自同构的代数熵增长。猜想：有限生成代数自同构的代数熵为零或无穷的二分在 PI 类内成立；非 PI 类的中间熵例子的最小代数为 Veronese 型且其熵为对数代数数。（代数熵二分阈值）
========================================
